objective: Implement and execute the file-backed P0-B R1 TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL evaluation without entering later retrieval or product stages.
invariants: P0-A frozen reports and artifacts are immutable.
TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL remains character 2-4 gram TF-IDF with Top-K 5.
DeepSeek receives only the current question and its current Top-5; it never receives full transcript, Gold, or answer points.
The three videos are processed locally; the answer workflow never uploads video.
No Mock result can satisfy the P0-B evaluation.
The run stops at the P0-B report and owner decision.
acceptance: TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL raw Top-K is persisted before answerer execution.
TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL has one result slot per frozen question, including explicit failures.
Deterministic retrieval/provenance/temporal graders and owner semantic-review material exist.
